title: Bowl Not Locked
fullDescription: Safety interlock prevents motor start when bowl misaligned.

fixSteps.title: Re-seat bowl
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate bowl until handle locks against base.

title: Lid Not Locked
fullDescription: Cover tab not rotated into locked detent.

fixSteps.title: Lock lid
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate lid clockwise until arrows align.

title: Thermal Cutoff
fullDescription: Thermal switch tripped after sustained run.

title: Pusher Not In
fullDescription: Some models require small pusher to be inserted.

fixSteps.title: Insert pusher
fixSteps.instruction: Place small pusher in feed tube.

title: Power Light Blinking
fullDescription: One or more interlocks not satisfied.

title: Clean Mode
fullDescription: Not an error - cycle in progress.

faq.a: Add drop of dish soap and water.

title: Lock stuck
fullDescription: Lid lock stuck. Common indication on Cuisinart food processor.

fixSteps.title: Test cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Run a normal cycle to verify.

whenToCallPro: If reset and cleaning don't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most issues are sensor/contact related — cleaning often fixes.
